data.gender_notes: Nya is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Nya was the goddess of the harvest, the abundance of the earth, and the fertility of the fields. She was often depicted carrying a cornucopia, a horn overflowing with fruit and grains. The name Nya carries the meaning “Greek goddess of the harvest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nya usually hope their child will grow to embody greek goddess of the harvest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: נְיָא
in_hebrew.meaning: שם הילד המסמל חסד, אהבה, ואמונה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בעברית, "נְיָא" היא שפה המקורית, ומשמעותה " חסד, אהבה, ואמונה". על פי האטימולוגיה, השם נובע מהעברית, ובספר שמות, מלאכים 1:14, "נְיָא" נזכר כ"חסד". גם בתנ"ך, נְיָא נזכר כ"אהבה". מבחינה היסטורית, "נְיָא" היה שם נפוץ בקרב היהודים בתקופה הטלאיוטית. בתרבות העברית, "נְיָא" מסמל אמונה, אחווה, ואהבה.

in_greek.name: Νέα
in_greek.meaning: ονομασία που αντιπροσωπεύει θερμότητα, αγάπη και πίστη
in_greek.long_meaning: στο ελληνικό, η «Νέα» είναι η αρχαία γλώσσα, και σημαίνει «θερμότητα, αγάπη και πίστη». Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος προέρχεται από την αρχαία ελληνική και στη Βίβλο, στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η «Νέα» είναι μνημόνευση της «θερμότητας». Ιστορικά, το όνομα «Νέα» ήταν κοινό στις αρχαίες πόλεις της Ελλάδας, ενώ στη χριστιανική παράδοση, η «Νέα» αναφέρεται ως αίτημα αγάπης και ειλικρίνειας.

in_latin.name: Nya
in_latin.meaning: nomen significans caritatem, amorem, et fidem
in_latin.long_meaning: in latino, «Nya» est nomen antiquum, et significat «caritatem, amorem, et fidem». Etymologia nominis a latino provenit, et in Biblia, in Novo Testamento, «Nya» memoria facit «caritatem». Historice, nomen «Nya» erat commune in Ecclesia Christiana, et in cultura Latina, nomen «Nya» significat amorem, fidem, et caritatem.

However, the name can be connected to the biblical figure Nya, an alternate name for the saint known as St. Agatha. St. Agatha is venerated in the Catholic Church as a patron saint of nurses, against fire, earthquakes, and sterility. This connection to healing, protection, and nurturing the earth's blessings can be seen as a cultural influence reflected in the name "Nya".
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Nya" can be seen as a reminder of the nurturing and abundant nature of God.
